statusText: Not yet passed (3 rounds so far)
intro: An AI agent wrote this page from saved copies of its sources. Separate AI checkers, which never saw the drafting, then checked it in rounds. This page has not passed yet: the version you see is a draft between rounds. In this trial, no person checked the facts. Here is what the checkers did and what they found.

sections.title: What we checked
paras: Each round runs the same checks. A page passes a round only when every check passes. Until then, each round's findings go into a new draft, and the next round starts fresh.
head: Check
What it does
Pass mark
rows: Code confirms that every sentence cites a source passage or is labeled as our analysis, that quotes match word for word, that numbers appear in the cited passage, that saved files match their fingerprints, and that the reading level is about grade 8 or lower.
A separate AI checker sees only this page and the source passages. For each sentence it must copy the exact words that support it, and code confirms those words are really there.

Three more AI checkers. One speaks up for Georgia Power's and the manufacturers' positions, one for the PSC's public-interest staff and the advocacy groups, and a neutral editor checks the rules. The editor also asks of each sentence: would we write it the same way about another party?
Both side reviewers give at least 4 of 5, and no serious problem
We hid 12 errors in a copy of the page, such as a wrong number, a quote credited to the wrong party and a wrong deadline time. The fact-checker had to find them without knowing they were there.

sections.title: What each round found
paras: This case has five parties and several separate questions, so it is harder to explain evenly than our other trials. Each round, the fact-check found less to fix, and the reviewers' remaining concerns moved from wording to structure: which side's numbers are shown, and where each side gets the last word.
head: Round

Result
rows: Failed. One claim wasn't supported by its source, and the editor found 4 serious problems
Failed. Each reviewer found missing points for its own side
Failed. Only the fuel side of a shift had dollar figures, and every evidence label came out "Mixed"

sections.title: What's next
items: Show the money on both sides: what more credit on the fuel side means for the base side of the bill.
Fix the evidence-label rule so labels can tell facts no party disputes from real disagreements.
Apply one rule for where each side's reply goes, and say which filings have had no written answer yet.
Make the top of the page shorter and define the remaining technical terms.

sections.title: What this can't do
paras: All the checkers are AI, like the writer, so they may share blind spots. Hiding test errors measures only the kinds of errors we thought to hide.

The checkers compare this page with the sources we saved. They can't tell what is missing from those sources. Some figures in the filings are blacked out, and one party's testimony is a scan we couldn't use.

sections.title: See every report
paras: Every check, report and fix is public in the project's repository, in trials/002-psc-57171-fuel-credit/verification.md.
